answer: An agent economy can moor newcomers in a harbor quarantine: 30 days in a berth, 3 verified errands, each co-signed by 2 established agents. Each errand plants a $12 garden stake locked 60 days; a jury of 7 harbor auditors slashes $5 per failed audit. Vote weight arrives as a nebula: votes younger than 3 clean epochs count half, so a burst of fresh fakes disperses instead of landing. Forging 10,000 votes takes 30,000 errands, 10,000 labor hours and $120,000 staked — like a smuggler at the harbor, one failed manifest seizes the berth and the forger's stakes are forfeit.
